in_sanskrit.name: सूरान्जन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Suranjan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' meaning good and 'rānjana' meaning news, joy or pleasure. This name signifies the arrival of good news, prosperity, and auspiciousness. It is a name that is believed to bring happiness and fortune.

in_hindi.name: सूरान्जन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Suranjan in Hindi is transliterated as 'Sūrānjana'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' meaning good and 'rājana' meaning king or ruler. It signifies a good and prosperous king or a ruler who brings good news and happiness. It is also a name that is believed to be auspicious and fortunate.

in_tamil.name: சூராஞ்ஜன
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Suranjan in Tamil is transliterated as 'Cūrāñjana'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' meaning good and 'rājana' meaning king or ruler. It signifies a king who is rich in speech, virtuous, auspicious, and benevolent. It is also a name that is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.

in_telugu.name: శూరాఞ్జన
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Suranjan in Telugu is transliterated as 'Shūrāñjana'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' meaning good and 'rājana' meaning king or ruler. It signifies a king who is good, virtuous, prosperous, auspicious, and wealthy. It is also a name that is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Suranjan
